claim: SEC submissions and filing documents expose accession identifiers and filing acceptance metadata suitable for PIT document packets.
impact_on_spec: Use accession, acceptance time, source URL and content hash for filing provenance.
limitations: SEC metadata is not an earnings-call transcript and collection requires fair-access identification.

claim: Automated SEC access must identify the client and respect fair-access request behavior.
impact_on_spec: Live collection blocks when SEC_USER_AGENT lacks a contact email or URL and rate-limits requests.
limitations: Access policy can change and must be refreshed before operational use.

claim: Alpha Vantage documents timestamped ticker-aware news and sentiment fields subject to API coverage and plan limits.
impact_on_spec: Keep Alpha Vantage optional and block historical claims while credentials and measured coverage are absent.
limitations: No workspace credential is configured and free-tier historical coverage is unverified.

claim: GDELT DOC provides broad timestamped document discovery that can support forward event and narrative monitoring.
impact_on_spec: Use as forward discovery only until entity resolution, duplicates and history are measured.
limitations: Broad noisy coverage and metadata do not establish paper-ready company-news evidence.

claim: A recent working paper reports that LLM filtering of 10-K semantic-network edges improved its historical cross-stock signal relative to embedding similarity alone.
impact_on_spec: Add economic-relation extraction as a future candidate, not as a current live signal.
limitations: Working-paper backtest, different universe and exposed historical period; requires independent replication.

claim: A recent working paper combines text-proposed regime candidates with statistical validation rather than accepting LLM regime labels directly.
impact_on_spec: Require market-data confirmation for any LLM narrative/regime feature.
limitations: Treasury-market study does not establish equity momentum lift.

claim: A recent working paper reports that adding earnings-call acoustic features degraded its text-only downside-risk model.
impact_on_spec: Do not add speech features without a single-modality baseline and marginal-lift test.
limitations: Working-paper result is a boundary condition, not a universal rejection of audio.

claim: A recent working paper studies whether explicit reflexivity framing changes LLM behavior in anonymized historical market forecasts.
impact_on_spec: Treat narrative framing as a prompt variant requiring a bounded ledger and anonymized placebo, not as established Alpha.
limitations: Zero-shot historical forecasting remains vulnerable to prompt and model dependence.

claim: Nonlinear asset-pricing models can extract interactions among momentum, liquidity and volatility, while shallow models remain competitive in low-signal panels.
impact_on_spec: Retain linear, tree and ranking comparisons with fold-local feature selection.
limitations: The paper uses a broader PIT universe and longer history than this exploratory dataset.

claim: Momentum losses cluster in stressed reversal regimes, motivating a separate state/risk role rather than unconditional model replacement.
impact_on_spec: Keep train-only regime gates and deterministic fallback.
limitations: Long-short crash evidence may overstate risk for a long-only Top-K portfolio.

claim: R&D-Agent(Q) links hypothesis generation, factor implementation and empirical feedback in an iterative quant workflow.
impact_on_spec: Persist source, claim, trial, model and decision links across rounds.
limitations: Agent breadth increases multiple-testing risk unless candidate generation is bounded and holdouts are isolated.

claim: AlphaBench emphasizes executable alpha generation, empirical evaluation, diversity and OOS generalization rather than trusting LLM self-evaluation.
impact_on_spec: Search hits remain unvalidated candidates until deterministic experiments and placebos adjudicate them.
limitations: Benchmark performance is not evidence for this data source or portfolio.
